description.en: Recordings, transcripts, and word-by-word playback, beautifully in sync.
description.zh: 整理录音和转写文本，让逐字高亮跟着声音一起播放。

source.description: Audio recording management and transcription with word-level karaoke playback

subject.en: Original chestnut faceted lyrebird with a curled feather crest
subject.zh: 保留原图的栗色碎片化琴鸟与卷曲羽冠

description.en: The portrait, beak, eye, curled crest, and native spacing remain the original artwork. This pass preserves the existing neck silhouette and adds no extension.
description.zh: 头像、鸟喙、眼神、卷曲羽冠与原有留白均沿用原图，保留现有颈部轮廓，没有补画或拉伸。

description.en: The existing warm facets and expressive feather crest carry the identity. Every original pixel is retained; no new rainbow accessory or model output is introduced.
description.zh: 暖色碎片与灵动的羽冠继续承担识别特征。所有原始像素均保留，不新增彩虹配饰，也不重新生图。

description.en: Unequal feather ribs open around a chestnut paper field. Small raised edges, fine grain, and a shallow shadow separate the bird from its warm setting.
description.zh: 疏密不一的扇羽纹围绕栗棕纸面展开，细亮边、微颗粒与浅阴影将鸟的轮廓从暖色底面中托出。

sizeNote.en: The eye, beak, and warm silhouette remain legible at sidebar size. Individual crest facets simplify at 16 px; use the transparent original for browser and menu bar marks.

description.zh: 长短不同的弧形羽肋组成两片偏心扇羽，开口之间保留宽松的呼吸空间。

alt.en: Original chestnut faceted lyrebird with a curled feather crest on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 保留原图的栗色碎片化琴鸟与卷曲羽冠，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.en: Every word, in its own time.
caption.zh: 每个词，都有准确的时刻。

description.en: Chestnut faceted lyrebird with a curled feather crest.
description.zh: 栗色碎片化琴鸟与卷曲羽冠。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥45px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 45px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
